annotations.description: 告警条件：最近5分钟至少20次请求，P95超过5000ms并持续3分钟。恢复表示条件不再满足，也可能是样本不足，不等同于确认接口变快。

model.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(path, method, le) (rate(fba_request_cost_time_bucket{app_name="fba_server", path!="/metrics", path!="__unmatched__", path!="/api/v1/oauth2/wechat/miniapp/login"}[5m])))

(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(path, method, le) (rate(fba_request_cost_time_bucket{app_name="fba_server", path!="/metrics", path!="__unmatched__", path!="/api/v1/oauth2/wechat/miniapp/login"}[5m]))) > bool 5000) * on(path, method) (sum by(path, method) (increase(fba_request_cost_time_count{app_name="fba_server", path!="/metrics", path!="__unmatched__", path!="/api/v1/oauth2/wechat/miniapp/login"}[5m])) >= bool 20)

annotations.description: 告警条件：最近5分钟请求数不足20次，但至少出现一次超过10000ms的请求，条件持续1分钟。统计窗口结束后的恢复不等同于证明接口变快。

model.expr: clamp_min(sum by(path, method) (increase(fba_request_cost_time_count{app_name="fba_server", path!="/metrics", path!="__unmatched__", path!="/api/v1/oauth2/wechat/miniapp/login"}[5m])) - sum by(path, method) (increase(fba_request_cost_time_bucket{app_name="fba_server", path!="/metrics", path!="__unmatched__", path!="/api/v1/oauth2/wechat/miniapp/login", le="10000.0"}[5m])), 0)

(clamp_min(sum by(path, method) (increase(fba_request_cost_time_count{app_name="fba_server", path!="/metrics", path!="__unmatched__", path!="/api/v1/oauth2/wechat/miniapp/login"}[5m])) - sum by(path, method) (increase(fba_request_cost_time_bucket{app_name="fba_server", path!="/metrics", path!="__unmatched__", path!="/api/v1/oauth2/wechat/miniapp/login", le="10000.0"}[5m])), 0) >= bool 0.5) * on(path, method) (sum by(path, method) (increase(fba_request_cost_time_count{app_name="fba_server", path!="/metrics", path!="__unmatched__", path!="/api/v1/oauth2/wechat/miniapp/login"}[5m])) < bool 20)
